title: Phase equilibria in systems containing hydrogen, carbon dioxide, water and hydrocarbons
experimental_method: static-analytical method in a 1000 cm3 autoclave with electromechanically driven stirrer; phases sampled through thermostated capillaries, liquid part collected in cold traps (water by Karl Fischer, hydrocarbons by GC), gas part volume measured in burettes.
uncertainties_stated: temperature < 1 K; pressure < 50 kPa; composition accuracy about 1 mol% (calibration and reproducibility of the analysis)
quality_remarks: Phase labels of Table 2 are 'Hydrocarbon Phase' / 'Aqueous Phase' / 'Vapor Phase'; row 573.15 K, 10.1 MPa, x1 = 0.996 (water-rich, y1 = 0.921) is printed under the hydrocarbon heading. Printed dashes mark absent phases. CO2 contents are not printed.
